name: Punyadeepa Khamari / पुण्यदीपा खमारी

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Punyadeepa Khamari writes poetry in Odia and Hindi. Timepass Odisha featured her in its Agami Akshar series introducing a new generation of Odia writers, and the Kalinga Literary Festival’s 2025 programme listed her among the participants in ‘Odia Kabita Ra Nua Swara’. These appearances place her work within a wider conversation among emerging Odia voices.

Her Hindi poem ‘आस’ unfolds in three small movements: a window and the moon, rain and the clouds that make it possible, a river and the sea. Each turns longing into a question of encounter. The closing image gives the river a thirst of its own, asking the beloved to recognise the desire that travels toward them.
